t: What Counterexample Database Is All About
title: What Counterexample Database Is All About
description: Counterexamples kill the false: one instance disproving the universal — the Weierstrass function (continuous nowhere differentiable), Russell's paradox (the set of all sets). The collection: Steen/Seebach (topology), Gelbaum/Olmsted (analysis). The lesson: conjecture boldly, test ruthlessly. The counterexample is the conjecture's executioner. This database is the complete counterexample: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
